q2_gaps: a means/method PP headed by 'by' whose object is an abstract procedure ('decides by consensus') — Manner is restricted to how-adverbs, Instrument is glossed as a tool, substance or conduit, and the preposition-named oblique is reserved for aboutness PPs, so no slot cleanly covers it
review.notes: 'The Council' correctly stays a capitalized common noun (no Name, no GroupOf) and the singular collective takes a plain unmarked event with no distribution rule. Instrument is the closest licensed 'means' slot for a how-PP, but its stated filler range (tool/substance/conduit) does not include an abstract procedure.
